verdict.rationale: Kong's GitHub README documents gateway authentication and authorization for APIs using JWT, basic auth, OAuth, ACLs and more, and describes authentication as a core gateway function. It also offers a quickstart that adds authentication to an API in under 5 minutes, configured through its plugin model. missing for 10: explicit evidence of API-key (key-auth) and mTLS plugins, in-depth first-party plugin docs for each auth method, independent/hands-on corroboration.
